summary.text: Akure was founded by Alakure, but its kings descend from Omoremilekun Asodeboyede, a prince from Ile-Ife who conquered Alakure’s people; one tradition says its ruling houses also descend from the Owa of Ijesha through Princess Owawejokun. War with Benin later drew its communities closer together.

founders.text: Asodeboyede, a descendant of Oduduwa from Ile-Ife, who founded the present dynasty.
The ruling houses claim descent from the Owas of Ijesha through Princess Owawejokun.
